decision: Analog Rytm MKII module: rytm2_mods' elemod port of MrScruff's rytm-mods 0013-voice-dac at his update 3a98e23, for OS 1.74, imported under GPL-2.0-only with attribution. rytm-mods-src is published with MrScruff's permission.

transformations: mod.json's 27 OS 1.74 port sites became address, length and SHA-256 guards in build.json's 1.74 release. Its bytes sites keep their new bytes; its ptr and jmp sites keep their targets.
mod.json's storage fields (vd_flt, vd_shp, vd_dac), its ev_project subscription and its core_page_fns, core_params and core_view_pages entries became build.json's storage, subscribe and contribute.
The OS 1.73 source and sites are not imported: core-ar2 0.3 and later are for OS 1.74 only.
include/ar2-1.74.inc and shared/shared.s keep their paths relative to the source, so the .include lines in src/voice-dac.s are unchanged.
